prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [反例] 交错跨列 · 共享中间列 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Merged cells: "与业务方共同梳理核心流程，输出需求说明书并完成评" spans 2 col × 1 row; "完成核心模块开发与联调，接入统一认证与日志平台" spans 2 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "项目" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "阶段一" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 3: header "阶段二" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "阶段三" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示需求、开发和测试工作在三个阶段中的安排，包括跨阶段的连续任务。","reading":"先按行查看各项工作，再横向比较阶段；跨列单元格表示任务覆盖相邻阶段，行高可容纳自然换行。","groups":["第2至第4列都是阶段列，需要保持可比较的视觉分量；第3列同时参与两处交错的跨列任务。","第1列是项目类别，帮助读者定位各行，所需宽度小于阶段列。"],"keep_intact":["项目类别“需求”“开发”“测试”","阶段一、阶段二、阶段三等列标题","单元格中的短标签和自然词组尽量保持完整"],"may_wrap":["需求说明和开发联调等长任务描述可按中文语义自然换行。","同一行较长任务造成的行高可供其他单元格的内容换行使用。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [52, 94, 117, 96] · table 360×216px · row heights [36, 83, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [52, 99, 110, 98] · table 360×216px · row heights [36, 83, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [51, 96, 116, 96] · table 360×262px · row heights [60, 83, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"项目类别和各阶段标题均保持完整；两个跨阶段任务各自清晰成组，阶段列的分量也较均衡。","problems":"“搭建脚手架”被拆成两行，第二行只有一个字，削弱了开发行的阅读节奏。","cause":"阶段一宽94px，扣除21px的内边距和边框后，文本空间不足以容纳77px的短标签。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"项目类别、阶段标题和“搭建脚手架”均保持完整；长任务自然换行，两处跨列任务都容易横向阅读。三个阶段列的比例均衡，行与行之间的节奏清楚。","problems":"需求说明的末行只有“评审”，略显零碎；开发任务的末行较长，但仍可读。","cause":"阶段一与阶段二合计209px，跨列单元格的可用宽度使需求说明落成三行，末行较短。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"阶段列宽度接近，两个长任务仍能保持清晰的跨列关系。","problems":"“项目”和三个项目类别全部竖向拆行，表头及短内容行因此变高；“搭建脚手架”也被拆成两行，整体节奏松散。","cause":"项目列51px，扣除21px后只有30px文本空间，小于两字所需的31px；阶段一96px也不足以容纳77px的短标签及21px的内边距和边框。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r3A","widths":[52,102,110,95],"change":"以r2B为基础，将阶段一加宽3px，给短标签更多余量，并略增需求跨列任务的宽度；从阶段三让出3px，同时保留阶段列之间相近的视觉分量。"},{"name":"r3B","widths":[52,98,116,93],"change":"保持阶段一容纳完整短标签的最低宽度，将更多空间分给两处跨列任务共享的阶段二，观察能否改善两段长文的断行，同时让阶段三保持足够宽度。"},{"name":"r3C","widths":[52,105,105,97],"change":"尝试让前两个阶段等宽，增加阶段一的呼吸感；两处跨列任务仍共享足够空间，并维持三个阶段列相近的比例。"}]}
